mysterious_traveler_start.text: Greetings, daoist. You look like someone who can handle themselves. There's a slime infestation nearby. Will you help?

choices.text: I have no time for slimes.

mysterious_traveler_accept.text: Excellent! Purge those slimes and I shall reward you with a Realm Token.

mysterious_traveler_greedy.text: Pah! Young cultivators these days... Fine. I'll throw in some extra Spirit Pills.

stele_mystic_01.text: 'Breath of the Dragon, Heart of the Sun.' You feel a surge of Qi flowing through your veins as you read these words.

elder_wei_start.text: Greetings, traveler. The bats in these woods have become aggressive due to the shifting Qi. Could you help clear them out?

elder_wei_accept.text: Thank you. Come back when you've dealt with 3 of them. Take these Spirit Pills as an advance.
